SUtil.allFiles.title: All files access required
SUtil.allFiles.message:
To let every Android user put mods/saves in the public folder (no root, file manager can access directly), please grant "All files access".

If you decline, the game will use the app-specific directory instead, and mod installation will be more troublesome.
SUtil.overlay.title: Floating keyboard
SUtil.overlay.message:
SeiunEngine wants to show a floating keyboard button over other apps.

Please allow "Display over other apps" in the next screen.
SUtil.error.permissionMessage: Permission error occurred. Please grant storage permissions manually.
